Notification can fail after acceptance; retry must send the accepted comment identity without changing what was committed. details.errorCorrection: The notification can be delivered for a comment that was never accepted, or the accepted comment may be missing after a send failure. A slow notification for one document should not block unrelated comment acceptance. The current editor or document revision may differ from the accepted comment's author and target.
details.boundaryOrTradeoff: The nearest alternative is send the notification before committing and create the comment only after delivery succeeds. It appears to make each step locally safe, but the case requires readers to observe the related values as one accepted revision.
details.transfer: Name the exact state revision readers may observe; commit its related values together, and publish derived notifications only at the boundary the scenario permits.
